title: Nera Vale
paragraph_text: Nera Vale, also called N. Vale, founded the Lumen Club in 2001.

title: Lumen Tower
paragraph_text: Nera Vale built Lumen Tower in 2001. Orin Reed painted the nearby gate in 2003.

title: Lumen ferry record
paragraph_text: The Lumen ferry did not operate in 2004. It operated in 2005.

title: Lumen Lighthouse
paragraph_text: Nera Vale designed Lumen Lighthouse. Orin Reed built Lumen Lighthouse.

title: Lumen Archive
paragraph_text: Lumen Archive is in Vale City. Its collection contains 30 maps. The archive opened in 2010.

title: Lumen Hall
paragraph_text: Lumen Hall is in Vale City. It opened in 2008. The hall has 40 seats.
